name: Set.mem_iUnion₂
type: {γ : Type u} → {ι : Sort v} → {κ : ι → Sort w} → {x : γ} → {s : (i : ι) → κ i → Set γ} → (x ∈ ⋃ (i) (j), s i j) ↔ ∃ i j, x ∈ s i j
provides: Membership in a doubly indexed union is witnessed by membership in one indexed cell; the second index can be a proof that the first is in an allowed set.
